previous_statement: For c,d in U(1), bilinearity gives (cU) bold-dot(dV)=(cd)(U bold-dot V). Scalar preservation of calU from node 1.1 and global domain membership from lem-stage1-approximate-group-laws put both U bold-dot V and (cU) bold-dot(dV) in S_delta. Applying lem-stage1-polar-coherence-naturality with scalar cd yields mu(cU,dV)=u_delta((cd)(U bold-dot V))=cd*u_delta(U bold-dot V)=c*d*mu(U,V).
new_statement: For every c,d in U(1) and U,V in calU, mu(cU,dV)=c*d*mu(U,V). Child 1.3.1.1 proves directly from def-approximate-unitary-space and the conjugate-linearity and bilinearity in def-epsilon-cstar-algebra that scalar multiples cU and dV remain in calU. Child 1.3.1.2 then applies lem-stage1-approximate-group-laws to obtain the required S_delta domain memberships, uses bilinearity to identify (cU) bold-dot (dV)=(cd)(U bold-dot V), and applies lem-stage1-polar-coherence-naturality with the scalar cd to obtain the displayed covariance identity.
